inputs.description: fixed corpora hardcoded in type_tree_probe.cc; no external dataset and no RNG. All 26 id::builtin and all 14 id::action values through builtins_properties/actions_properties; 35 single-vertex cases; 62 combo programs (roughly half of them deliberately ILL-TYPED, covering the arity, operand-type and cross-argument mismatch families separately); 39 type-tree pairs for inherit/equal/intersection; 32 reduce_type_tree cases with and without an arg_types vector; the full type_node stream round trip; and convert_index / abs_min_arity / get_type_node / default_vertex_value / is_argument_type / arg_to_idx tables
